uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-6798-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-6798-7936.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

277-1308-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

801-997-5220-7855.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

338-3197-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1594-4399-4770-5468.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2034-3490-4875-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-3490-4875-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Conspiracy, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

803-2624-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Oketra.
As God-Eternal Oketra is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5496-7147-7646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4050-7084-7396.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

240-2921-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-7296.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-7296.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

997-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

280-1399-1606-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5220-6650-6798.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4871-5220-6650-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6650-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2366-3430-4885-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-4885-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2374-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2374-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

997-3284-3490-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

549-856-5231-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-4195-4574-4708.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-6794.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-5058-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1350-2726-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Biovisionary spell.
Resolve both Biovisionary spells.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time, and then repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1308-1651-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing the Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

719-1432-1486-1753.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
719-1432-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability. You can also use Ioreth's second ability instead.

222-527-969-997.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-997.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1309-5195-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Salvager of Secrets
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2558-2981-4848-5687.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

222-2018-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
222-2018-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and another nontoken creature without flying, adding {B}{R}.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Luminous Broodmoth triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the second Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning the other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and the other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2167-4488-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-4488-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

147-3645-3967.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3859-4772-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
3859-4772-5554.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-2034-3498-3613.description:
Cast Baithook Angler from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Hook-Haunt Drifter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hook-Haunt Drifter, adding {2}.
Because Dress Down causes Hook-Haunt Drifter to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Baithook Angler.
Repeat.

914-2178-3379-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
914-2178-3379-4050.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1671-3525-3932.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
1671-3525-3932.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
